title: Data Visualization
description: Learn data visualization principles including chart selection, data storytelling, color theory, and dashboard design.

modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Data Visualization.

content.text: Welcome to Lesson 1 of Data Visualization. In this lesson, you'll learn about Data Fundamentals—a fundamental concept in Data & Analytics.
Core Concept: Data Fundamentals
Every great data visualization practitioner starts with understanding Data Fundamentals. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: The most successful practitioners in Data & Analytics always practice Data Fundamentals before moving to more advanced topics.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Data Fundamentals without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main purpose of Data Fundamentals in Data Visualization?
content.explanation: The goal of Data Fundamentals is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Data Fundamentals to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
